title: Chilli con Carne
ingredients: 400g beans (canned white beans in tomato sauce)
instructions: Chop up onions and fry on some oil until translucent. Add garlic by the end of this, fry for 30s.
Add seasoned meat and fry until brown.
Add tomatoes, stock, chocolate, chilli powder. Cook until thick and reduced.
Add corn and beans and cook for few more minutes.
